with not_flagged as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from orders s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from order_items c
            where c.order_id = s.id
              and c.unit_price <= 380
        )
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        avg(amount) over (partition by status order by discount, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_avg_amount,
        max(amount) over (partition by status order by discount, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_max_amount,
        min(amount) over (partition by status order by discount, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_min_amount,
        sum(amount) over (partition by status order by discount, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_sum_amount,
        row_number() over (partition by channel order by shipping_fee desc, id) as seq_no
    from not_flagged
),
with_window as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        a.*,
        sub.id as subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    from enriched a
    left join subscriptions sub
        on a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       and a.order_date >= sub.start_date
       and a.order_date < sub.end_date + interval '14' day
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.*,
        d.signup_date,
        d.country,
        d.credit_limit
    from with_window e
    left join customers d
        on e.customer_id <=> d.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    date_trunc('week', order_date) as week_start,
    customer_id,
    size(collect_set(plan)) as num_plans,
    sum(case when plan = 'basic' then last3_max_amount else 0 end) as basic_last3_max_amount,
    round(avg(last3_avg_amount), 2) as avg_last3_avg_amount,
    count(distinct status) as distinct_status,
    corr(discount, amount) as corr_discount_amount,
    percentile_approx(seq_no, 0.95) as seq_no_p95
from joined
group by date_trunc('week', order_date), customer_id
having percentile_approx(seq_no, 0.95) >= 0
order by corr_discount_amount desc;

        id,
        product_name,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,

remaining_keys AS (

    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT supplier_id, brand
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date > '2024-05-01'
),

    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation

    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.supplier_id = k.supplier_id AND s.brand = k.brand
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.store_id IN (1, 2, 4, 6)
        )
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.product_name,
        src.brand,
        src.price,
        src.cost,
        src.stock_qty,
        src.tags,
        src.supplier_id,
        b.country,
        b.supplier_name

    -- Ranking and gap features

        id,
        product_name,

    FROM joined

    CORR(stock_qty, cost) AS corr_stock_qty_cost,
    STDDEV_SAMP(cost) AS cost_stddev
FROM enriched

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(level, 1, 4) level_prefix,
        TRIM(full_name) clean_full_name
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary < 130000
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id), 4) salary_share,
        SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_salary,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title), 4) salary_share_2,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title), 4) salary_share_3,
        LAG(salary, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY hire_date, id) prev_salary
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE salary >= 98000
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT dept_id, manager_id
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT dept_id, manager_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IN ('L2', 'L4')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id AND s.manager_id = k.manager_id
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM verified
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE is_remote = FALSE
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.job_title AS employee_job_title
    FROM reconciled e
    LEFT JOIN employees b
        ON e.manager_id = b.id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    e.job_title AS employee_job_title,
    e.level AS employee_level,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    MAX(a.salary) AS max_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(a.salary_share_3), 2) AS avg_salary_share_3,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM joined a
INNER JOIN employees e ON a.manager_id = e.id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((e.job_title, e.level), (e.job_title))
ORDER BY max_salary;

ORDER BY product_id;

        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        COALESCE(country, 'Unknown') AS country_filled
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-27 01:00:00'

    -- Attach customers attributes

        a.id,
        a.customer_id,
        a.started_at,
        b.credit_limit,
        b.signup_date,
        b.name
    FROM cleaned a
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON a.customer_id = b.id
),

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_dims
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation

    -- Attach customers attributes
